text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 白色花卉蕾丝喇叭袖开衫，棕色三角比基尼内搭，白色蕾丝低腰短裤，棕色侧绑泳裤系带，鞋未展示不加。仅服装与鞋袜；无可拆卸配饰。
original_prompt: Edit this neutral clothing-only catalogue photograph. Make the white floral lace shorts slightly longer, with clear short trouser legs and a 5 cm inseam, matching ordinary low-rise lace beach shorts. Keep the brown side ties, brown swim top, and open white lace cardigan exactly as shown. No new objects. Maintain pure white background, no person, no body, no mannequin, no text, realistic textile product photography.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。文字图案以视觉参考为主，未逐图重生成验证。
